To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a test signal generator and a built-in test circuit are provided in a circuit arrangement, that the test signal generator and the built-in test circuit can be controlled independently of each other, and that the test signal can be injected into a signal path at any point and the result can be checked at any other point.

the invention relates to a test circuit arrangement for a communications network, in particular a broadband switching network, comprising a plurality of switching modules, each module comprising at least one switching element and an input/output interface for connecting to the communications network.

the invention provides a novel circuit arrangement for a communications network, which comprises a built-in test-sigmal generator (TG) for generating a test signal and a built-in test-error detection circuit (PE) for checking the test signal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
an arrangement for testing a communication network, in particular a broadband communication network, which has a plurality of broadband communication modules.
the development of a novel circuit arrangement for testing a communication network and a test method using such a circuit arrangement.
the testing of large integrated circuits and of switching modules, and with the testing of switching networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present invention provides a test circuit arrangement for a switching module of a broadband switching network, which comprises a test-signal generator, a test-signal path, and a signal path for the switching module, which are connected in such a way that a test-signal generated by the test-signal source can be injected into the signal path at a first point of the signal-path, and that a signal taken at a second point of the signal-paths can be checked in an error-detection circuit.
the circuit arrangement of the invention is particularly suitable for the testing of broadband switching modules.
this circuit arrangement is particularly advantageous in large-scale-integrated circuit technology, where the circuit arrangement is formed on a chip.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a novel test circuit arrangement has been developed which can be used for testing of broadband switching networks, as well as for testing of large-scale integrated circuits already on the chip or on the wafer.

we have found a new, simple and inexpensive test method which is especially suited for testing large-scale-integrated systems and large-scale-integrated components already on the wa fer.
